title.purpose: The bold first line of an empty state.

wordmark.purpose: "Friends" in the dropdown header; 11px 600 tertiary ink in the sidebar.

body.purpose: Base size for all text, buttons (500) and tabs. Tabular figures.

meta.purpose: Lines under names, field labels, hints, small buttons, errors.

label.purpose: Sentence-case section labels over lists, and tags.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Sheets on the stock: cards, grouped lists, primary, outline and danger buttons.

shadows.name: press-in
shadows.purpose: Any push button while pressed, with translateY(0.5px).

shadows.name: field-inset
shadows.purpose: Text fields and selects at rest.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Text fields and selects when focused.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Button background, shadow and press offset; input focus shadow. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

sizes.name: row
sizes.purpose: Every list row in both windows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per pane, in press blue. Sinks into the stock when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--press, #3346c4); color: var(--on-press, #fff); box-shadow: var(--lift, 0 0.5px 0 rgb(29 34 51 / 6%), 0 1px 2px rgb(29 34 51 / 8%)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--press-down, #2a3aa6); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--press-down, #2a3aa6); box-shadow: var(--press-in, inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%)); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A white sheet button for a secondary step, such as Delete selected… before confirming.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2233); box-shadow: 0 0.5px 0 rgb(29 34 51 / 6%), 0 1px 2px rgb(29 34 51 / 8%), inset 0 0 0 0.5px var(--rule-strong, rgb(29 34 51 / 20%)); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: var(--well, #e4e7ee); box-shadow: var(--press-in, inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%)); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Groundless text button for Cancel, Edit, Keep and the dropdown footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #4f5568); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--press-tint, rgb(51 70 196 / 10%)); color: var(--ink, #1d2233); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: var(--well, #e4e7ee); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Done Button
components.description: Marks a person done. Sea green wherever it appears; solid on hover and press.
components.css: .ds-btn-done { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; background: var(--sea-tint, rgb(23 112 90 / 11%)); color: var(--sea, #17705a); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-done:hover { background: var(--sea, #17705a); color: var(--on-sea, #fff); } .ds-btn-done:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-done:active { background: var(--sea, #17705a); color: var(--on-sea, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: The confirming Delete only; appears after the outline Delete selected… step.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; background: var(--danger, #c4312b); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 0 rgb(29 34 51 / 6%), 0 1px 2px rgb(29 34 51 / 8%); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-down, #a72822); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: var(--danger-down, #a72822); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled 26px field on the sheet; blue inner stroke and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { color: var(--ink-2, #4f5568); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2233); font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--press, #3346c4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px var(--rule-strong, rgb(29 34 51 / 20%)), inset 0 1px 1px rgb(10 14 30 / 6%); transition: box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #5c6275); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--press, #3346c4), 0 0 0 3px var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); }

components.name: Sidebar Tabs
components.description: Mac source list for Preferences; selected tab is solid press blue, with an inverted count tag.
components.html: Friends
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 168px; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--sidebar, #e6e9f0); border-right: 0.5px solid var(--rule-strong, rgb(29 34 51 / 20%)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { margin: 4px 8px 12px; color: var(--ink-3, #5c6275); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--ink, #1d2233); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; font-family: inherit; text-align: left; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--press-tint, rgb(51 70 196 / 10%)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--press, #3346c4); color: var(--on-press, #fff); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; min-width: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--press, #3346c4); color: var(--on-press, #fff); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 17px; text-align: center; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-tag { background: var(--on-press, #fff); color: var(--press, #3346c4); }

components.name: Person Row on a Sheet
components.description: The signature: a white grouped list of 48px rows with disc, name, meta line (amber when missed) and Done.
components.html:
• M
    Maya Chen
    Missed last time · aim for Sat, Nov 21
  • T
    Theo Marsh
    Aim for today
components.css: .ds-sheet { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--sheet, #fff); box-shadow: 0 0.5px 0 rgb(29 34 51 / 6%), 0 1px 2px rgb(29 34 51 / 8%); font: 13px/1.38 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1d2233); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--rule, rgb(29 34 51 / 11%)); } .ds-disc { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-meta { margin-top: 1px; color: var(--ink-2, #4f5568); font-size: 12px; } .ds-row[data-overdue="true"] .ds-meta { color: var(--amber, #96600c); } .ds-done { min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sea-tint, rgb(23 112 90 / 11%)); color: var(--sea, #17705a); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-done:hover { background: var(--sea, #17705a); color: var(--on-sea, #fff); } .ds-done:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-done:active { background: var(--sea, #17705a); color: var(--on-sea, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Tags
components.description: Small pills: press-blue count tag, amber Due tag after a name.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; min-width: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 11px/17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-pill-count { background: var(--press, #3346c4); color: var(--on-press, #fff); } .ds-pill-due { background: var(--amber-tint, rgb(150 96 12 / 11%)); color: var(--amber, #96600c); }

components.name: Selection Bar
components.description: Press-tint strip above the People list: count and way out on the left, the destructive step alone at the far right.
components.html: 2 selected
components.css: .ds-selbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--press-tint, rgb(51 70 196 / 10%)); font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1d2233); } .ds-count { font-weight: 600; } .ds-q { margin-right: auto; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #4f5568); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; } .ds-q:hover { background: var(--press-tint, rgb(51 70 196 / 10%)); color: var(--ink, #1d2233); } .ds-o { min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2233); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 0 rgb(29 34 51 / 6%), 0 1px 2px rgb(29 34 51 / 8%), inset 0 0 0 0.5px var(--rule-strong, rgb(29 34 51 / 20%)); } .ds-q:focus-visible, .ds-o:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(51 70 196 / 42%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-o:active { background: var(--well, #e4e7ee); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(10 14 30 / 28%); transform: translateY(0.5px); }

narrative.overview:
Friends is two inks printed on good card stock. Text is deep indigo ink rather than black, actions are one press-blue spot ink, "done" is sea green, and "missed" is amber. The ground is a cool fog stock (never cream), and content sits on white sheets laid on it. Colour is flat: no gradients, no glass, no glow.

It is a native Mac utility first. Type is the system face (SF Pro) at macOS control sizes, figures are tabular, and the layouts follow the Mac's own grammar: a menu bar dropdown that fills its window edge to edge, and a settings window with a source-list sidebar and inset grouped lists. Density is calm and fixed; one 48px row scale is shared by the dropdown and Preferences.

The signature is the impression: push buttons press into the stock when clicked (an inset shadow and half a pixel down) instead of lighting up.
keyCharacteristics: Cool fog stock, white sheets, indigo ink; dark mode keeps the same roles on charcoal stock.
One action ink (press blue); sea green only for done and caught up; amber for missed.
Flat colour, hairline (0.5px) dividers, one soft lift under sheets.
Buttons press in on click; nothing glows.
System type only, 11 to 20px, tabular figures everywhere.

rules.name: The Missed Is Amber Rule
rules.body: A missed day is information, not failure: it is printed in amber, never red. Red (danger) is for destructive actions (Delete) and error messages only.

rules.name: The One Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Press blue is the only colour that means "act here" or "selected". Do not introduce a second action colour.

rules.name: The Done Is Sea Rule
rules.body: Sea green marks completion and nothing else; every Done button uses it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular across the whole app (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on the root).

rules.name: The One Row Rule
rules.body: Every list row in the dropdown and in Preferences uses the same 48px row, 28px disc and 12px gap.

rules.name: The Impression Rule
rules.body: Buttons respond to a press by sinking into the stock, never by glowing, scaling up, or casting a bigger shadow.

dos: **Do** use the role tokens in `src/styles.css` for every colour, size, radius and gap, so light and dark mode both follow.
**Do** keep every list row at 48px with a 28px disc, in both windows.
**Do** use press blue for every primary action and selected state, and nothing else.
**Do** print Done in sea green wherever it appears.
**Do** show pressed buttons with the press-in shadow and a 0.5px drop.
**Do** use 0.5px hairlines between rows instead of borders around them.
**Do** keep the 3px focus ring visible on every control, and let reduced motion turn transitions off.
donts: **Don't** use red for a missed day; missed is amber.
**Don't** use red for anything but deleting and error messages.
**Don't** add gradients, glass, blur or glows; colour is flat.
**Don't** use cream or warm paper for the stock; it is cool fog.
**Don't** load web fonts; the system face is the only face.
**Don't** add a second action colour beside press blue.
